mil3.4.10:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, does one who has not attained extinguishment know: ‘Extinguishment is happiness’?”
mil3.4.10:1.3: “Yes, Great King, one who has not attained extinguishment knows: ‘Extinguishment is happiness’.”
mil3.4.10:1.4: “How, Venerable Nāgasena, does one who has not attained it know: ‘Extinguishment is happiness’?”
mil3.4.10:1.5: “What do you think, Great King: those whose hands and feet have not been cut off, would they know: ‘Cutting off hands and feet is painful’?”
mil3.4.10:1.8: “By hearing the cries of lamentation of others whose hands and feet have been cut off, venerable sir, they know: ‘Cutting off hands and feet is painful’.”
mil3.4.10:1.9: “In the same way, Great King, by hearing the voice of those who have seen extinguishment, one knows: ‘Extinguishment is happiness’.”
